Macrons

Consonantal i

Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas · Conversation, family & daily routines

visit verb

also go and see, pay a visit, call on, drop in on, look in on

classical

Cic. Fam. 9.23.1: ut et vidērem tē et vīserem
Traupman 110: visit, pay a visit to, vīsō

vīsō, vīsere, vīsī, vīsum

verb, third conjugation

go to see, visit (a person or a place)

Of going to see someone, especially to see how a sick person is (Lewis & Short), and of going to see a place. “Go and see” is also vīsum īre, with the supine (Gell. 12.1.2).

Other words

  • invīsō, invīsere, invīsī, invīsum — look in on, call on

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 12.30.1: quod Lentulum invīsis, valdē grātum; Traupman 97, 105: drop in on; pay s.o. a visit

  • vīsitō, vīsitāre, vīsitāvī, vīsitātum — visit, go to see (a sick person; often)

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Fin. 5.94: cum vīsitāsset hominem Carneadēs (Lewis & Short)

    Lewis & Short: “rare but classical” in this sense; common in Christian Latin.

  • salūtātum venīre — call on someone, pay one’s respects

    also used · classical · Gell. 16.5.9: quī dominum ejus domūs salūtātum vēnerant

Examples

  • tulī scīlicet molestē, ut dēbuī, sed tamen cōnstituī ad tē venīre, ut et vidērem tē et vīserem et cēnārem etiam; nōn enim arbitror cocum etiam tē arthrīticum habēre

    I was sorry, of course, as I ought to be; but all the same I’ve decided to come to you, to see you and visit you, and have dinner too, for I don’t suppose your cook has gout as wellCic. Fam. 9.23.1

  • quod Lentulum invīsis, valdē grātum

    It is very kind of you to look in on little LentulusCic. Att. 12.30.1

  • eāmus … et puerum vīsum et patrī grātulātum

    let’s go and see the baby and congratulate the fatherGell. 12.1.2

See also meet, guest, receive, doctor, visitor, host.
